description: This file defines base classes for Speech-to-Text (STT) services, including continuous and segmented processing, with support for websocket integration and VAD-based segmentation. It includes abstract methods for speech recognition implementation and manages audio frames, settings, and event handling.

classes.name: STTService
classes.description: Base class for speech-to-text services, providing common functionality and abstract method for actual speech recognition.

classes.name: SegmentedSTTService
classes.description: Derived class that processes speech in segments using VAD events, buffering audio and performing recognition on detected speech segments.

classes.name: WebsocketSTTService
classes.description: Websocket-enabled subclass combining STT functionality with websocket connectivity, handling errors and reconnections.

methods.name: set_language
methods.description: Sets the language for speech recognition (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Abstract method to run speech-to-text on provided audio data, yielding transcription frames.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service with start frame parameters.

methods.name: _update_settings
methods.description: Updates service settings based on provided configuration.

methods.name: process_audio_frame
methods.description: Processes individual audio frames for transcription, respecting mute state.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming frames, including VAD events and audio frames.

methods.name: _handle_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD event indicating user started speaking.

methods.name: _handle_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD event indicating user stopped speaking, triggers recognition on buffered audio.
